title: Sundar Pichai’s IIT batchmate became a famous monk; what he told him when they met years later
summary_full: Sundar Pichai, the CEO of Google, and Gauranga Das, an ISKCON monk, were IIT classmates back in 1993. Decades later, they reunited to explore their divergent journeys. Pichai leads a globally recognized tech powerhouse known for its stress-laden environment, while Das embraces a tranquil, faith-driven life. Their engaging conversation showcased the variety of success stories stemming from their shared educational background.
